title: Every member section opens on one shared Frequency header (kicker, serif title, meta, actions, search)
detail:
Page-header uniformity, parked 2026-10-14, active 2026-10-19. Survey: /mnt/project-files/header-survey.md. Today Circles, Marketplace, Crew and Vault each hand-roll a <div className="head"> (circles-body.tsx:125, marketplace-body.tsx:117, crew-body.tsx:379, vault-body.tsx:329); /nearby, Practices, Members, Journal and Notifications still render DAWN PageHero / IndexTemplate / FocusTemplate. Phase 1: one exported header component under components/frequency/members/shared used by the survey's bodies; phase 2: Leaderboard, Settings, Help, Site map and the DAWN-template pages; phase 3: the seven search boxes.

PHASE 1 SHIPPED 2026-10-20: one exported MemberHead (components/frequency/members/shared/member-head.tsx, same markup as the kit's .head) is now drawn by Circles, Marketplace (all four views), the Quest, Vault, Leaderboard, Settings, Site map, Journeys and Channels instead of nine hand-rolled copies. Output is unchanged. STILL OPEN: /nearby, Practices, Members, Journal and Notifications render DAWN PageHero, IndexTemplate or FocusTemplate in their Frequency branch; Help and the journey detail pages; and the seven search boxes. SEARCH BOXES 2026-10-20: Circles, Channels, Spaces and Marketplace already had one. Journeys now has it (GET ?q=, narrows Keep going, Yours and the library, the same FqFindField Circles uses). Settings now has one too (a Search settings pill that finds a pane by its name or any word in it, Enter opens the first match). Feed (Search the Feed, opens the Search page on its Posts tab) and Journal (Search your journal, narrows entries by their text) now have one. Practices already has its toolbar search. STILL OPEN: the DAWN-template pages in phase 2 (/nearby, Practices, Members, Journal and Notifications heads). PHASE 2 (2026-10-20): Journal and Notifications now draw the shared MemberHead through FqFocusPage under Frequency (FocusTemplate stays for DAWN). STILL OPEN: /nearby, Practices and Members heads, Help and the journey detail pages. Practices now opens on MemberHead with the kit search pill and Sort chips under Frequency (search, four sorts, hidden toggle, New practice, Review queue and CTA kept). STILL OPEN: /nearby and Members heads, Help and the journey detail pages. CLOSED 2026-10-20: premise re-tested. The Index, Stream and Focus templates already render the members kit .head under Frequency (PageHeading, ADR-1737), so /nearby, /network and the rest never drew DAWN's PageHero there. The last hand-rolled heads (Journey, Journey course, Mindless empty, the utility loading screens) now use MemberHead; the probe fails if any members-kit body hand-rolls a .head again or Journal/Notifications lose the shared head.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const w=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?w(p.join(d,e.name)):[p.join(d,e.name)]);const ok=["member-head.tsx","messages-states.tsx"];const q=String.fromCharCode(34);const needle="className="+q+"head"+q;const bad=w("components/frequency/members").filter(f=>f.endsWith(".tsx")&&!ok.includes(p.basename(f))&&fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").includes(needle));if(bad.length){console.error("LIVE-935: hand-rolled head in "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}for(const f of ["app/(main)/journal/page.tsx","app/(main)/notifications/page.tsx"]){if(!fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").includes("FqFocusPage")){console.error("LIVE-935: "+f+" lost its Frequency head");process.exit(1)}}'
